text: {"question":"How does the later study’s assessment of a dark radiation model’s ability to alleviate the Hubble tension differ from the earlier study’s ranking of early dark energy as the most effective mechanism?","reference_answer":"The later work shows that a dark‑radiation scenario with light pions can reduce the Hubble tension to about the 3σ level while keeping S₈ consistent, placing it among the top contenders. In contrast, the earlier analysis ranked early‑dark‑energy models as the best performers, with dark‑radiation models lagging behind until deviations from a pure power‑law spectrum were considered."}
